definitions.explanation: Treating something with care and protecting it from harm. Most commonly used in the context of animal welfare and nature conservation, but can also apply to people or cultural properties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧{愛護|あいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The spirit of animal welfare is important.

examples.japanese: {愛護|あいご}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{取|と}った→引き取る：06164_hikitoru⟧。
examples.english: I adopted a dog from the animal shelter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}{環境|かんきょう}→自然環境：22932_shizenkankyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛護|あいご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Caring for the natural environment is also a responsibility to the next generation.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (love) + {護|ご} (protect). Carries a nuance of compassionate protection — not just legal protection, but caring treatment motivated by affection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧{愛護|あいご} — animal welfare/protection
- {愛護|あいご}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧ — animal shelter (formally: animal welfare center)
- {愛護|あいご}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧ — animal welfare organization
- {動物|どうぶつ}{愛護|あいご}{法|ほう} — Animal Welfare Act
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{愛護|あいご} — nature conservation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ — protection (more general, legal/institutional emphasis)
- ⟦{保全|ほぜん}→保全：11560_hozen⟧ — conservation, preservation (environmental/ecological)
- ⟦{虐待|ぎゃくたい}→虐待：14046_gyakutai⟧ — abuse, mistreatment (opposite)
